items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: Yeah, Noon had been living right on the plantation then.

ctx.x: And then he moved over on this side, though, pretty soon.

That's right, when he sold Stanton Plantation out. Yeah. Old man Ruppley. Sold, uh, I mean, this, uh, Stanton sold plantation to Ruppley. And then, they moved. Yeah, Noon had been living right on the plantation then. Yeah, I was born there. Born there.
Well, uh, Nene Quacku. Nene Quacku. He was on this side. Nene Quacku from, uh, from, uh, Violets. Violets.
